chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Daumantas, Daugirdas, Áila, Dervla, Áila, Æthelred, Kaunikki, Lemmikki, Leofweard and Aodhín were among those who arrived in summer.

Daumantas, Kaunikki and Leofweard worked as hunters. Daugirdas, Æthelred and Aodhín worked as woodworkers. Áila, Dervla and Lemmikki worked as farmers. Áila worked as a fisher.

Daumantas and Dervla were already partners. Daugirdas and Lemmikki were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.
